questions.question: Verify Huygens’s position at the Paris Academy of Sciences and the statements that he was its first president and led it for fifteen years; agree the publication date of Treatise on Light, given as 1678 in the source.

localizations.source: Verify Huygens’s position at the Paris Academy of Sciences and the statements that he was its first president and led it for fifteen years; agree the publication date of Treatise on Light, given as 1678 in the source.
localizations.ru: Уточнить должность Гюйгенса в Парижской академии наук и формулировку о её первом президенте и пятнадцати годах руководства; согласовать дату выхода «Трактата о свете», указанную в исходнике как 1678 год.

questions.resolution: Huygens’s Academy status and the presentation/publication dates of Treatise on Light were corrected.

questions.question: Verify the priority claims concerning Saturn’s rings, the balance spring and the pocket watch, the work with Hooke on fixed temperature points, and the claim about the first book presenting heliocentrism in Russia.

localizations.source: Verify the priority claims concerning Saturn’s rings, the balance spring and the pocket watch, the work with Hooke on fixed temperature points, and the claim about the first book presenting heliocentrism in Russia.
localizations.ru: Проверить приоритеты открытий колец Сатурна, часовой спирали и карманных часов, совместную работу с Гуком над температурными точками и точность утверждения о первой книге с гелиоцентрической системой в России.

questions.resolution: The disputed balance-spring priority, thermometry and the Russian-edition claim were qualified.

questions.question: Confirm the original sources of the portrait, museum photograph and title page, and the basis for reproduction; the last two captions come from the source post’s illustration markers.

localizations.source: Confirm the original sources of the portrait, museum photograph and title page, and the basis for reproduction; the last two captions come from the source post’s illustration markers.
localizations.ru: Подтвердить первоисточники портрета, музейной фотографии и титульного листа, а также основание их воспроизведения; подписи двух последних перенесены из маркеров исходного поста.

questions.resolution: The three illustration captions remain without new claims.
